answer: Randomized Shard Assignment Gate. Each epoch, a public beacon emits a zephyr seed that assigns new agents to verification shards; assignment is unpredictable until the seed lands. A velvet delay holds onboarding until the seed is revealed, so attackers cannot precompute favorable placements. Because a sybil cluster must occupy many shards to influence quorum sampling, each extra identity triggers an independent voyage through costly hardware attestation and liveness checks, multiplying per-identity expense.
